notes: DATES: the products first in this file were researched 23–25 Oct 2026; researchedOn was moved to 26 Oct 2026 when the 2021 price list was added.

TOOLING LIMITATION: during this research the page-fetch tool could not resolve any host (DNS failure for every site, including finolexpipes.com), and the session web-search budget ran out before the end. All facts were taken from search-engine extracts of official finolexpipes.com product pages and Finolex catalogue PDFs (URLs in sourceUrls), not from directly opened pages. Spot-check against the live pages before publishing.

PRICES: no official current (2026) Finolex Industries price list could be found or opened. The 2021 Plumbing & Sanitation list added on 26 Oct 2026 (see the note below) is the only manufacturer price source in this file; marketPrice values are separate researched estimates.

IMAGES (added 25 Oct 2026): each product uses the product photo of its own finolexpipes.com page (the page's first product image, ahead of its line drawing and the related-products strip). The SDR 11 and SDR 13.5 CPVC pipes share the CPVC pipes page photo, and the ASTM Schedule 40 and Schedule 80 pipes share the ASTM pipes page photo, because Finolex lists each pair on one page.

Material codes in specifications are Finolex's own codes as shown on the product pages. They can help when ordering from the distributor. Finolex pages sometimes give conflicting codes for similar items (e.g. Selfit vs Ringfit SWR bends), so confirm with the distributor.
CPVC Pipe SDR 13.5: the product page lists 15–50 mm in SDR 11 and SDR 13.5, but one Finolex brochure lists only SDR 11. Confirm which SDR 13.5 sizes the distributor actually stocks.
CPVC pipes come in 3 m and 5 m lengths, and ASTM pipes in 3 m and 6 m, so altUnit is null for them. Set altUnit once the stocked length is known.

CPVC Reducer: the 2021 Finolex list gives all 15 combinations from 20 × 15 mm to 50 × 40 mm (codes 6126–6140); the six that were missing (40 × 15, 40 × 32, 50 × 15, 50 × 20, 50 × 32, 50 × 40 mm) were added from it.
CPVC Ball Valve: the size table lists 15–50 mm; the feature text on the same page says 15–80 mm. Only 15–50 mm is included. HSN set to 8481 (valves) per README; confirm with accountant.
CPVC FTA Brass Insert: the only source page found has an "-old" URL suffix. Sizes and codes come from that page.
CPVC Solvent Cement: Finolex lists pack sizes 59/118/237/473/946 labelled "gms" (PVC-U cements are labelled ml); the label is kept as Finolex shows it.

ASTM pipes and fittings: the products first researched covered only ½"–2". On 26 Oct 2026 the 2½"–8" sizes of the plain Schedule 40 and 80 pipes and of the coupler, plain elbow and plain tee were added from the 2021 list, and threaded-end pipes were added as separate products (the existing pipe products are the plain-end pipes). Threaded elbows and tees are made only up to 2".

Agriculture Selfit pipe: Finolex states 20–400 mm in six classes (2.5–12.5 kg/cm²). The class-wise dimension table could not be read cleanly, so the variant set (63/75/90/110 mm × 4 and 6 kg/cm²) is limited to common IS 4985 combinations. The 6 m standard length (altUnit) was read from the Selfit table for 75 mm; confirm for the other sizes.

Column pipe: the size/type rows come from a table extract without column headers. Lengths (1.5 m or 3 m) differ by size and type. The variants listed are rows seen in the extract. Confirm length and the relevant standard with the distributor before selling.

SWR: the 2021 list prices two separate fitting ranges – Selfit (solvent cement, codes 7584–7731) and fittings with integrated ring (codes 7501–7583). The existing SWR fittings were matched to the Selfit range: Bend 87.5° Plain by its material codes (7591–7593), the coupler and nahani trap by name. Bend 45° Plain, Plain Tee and Single Y Plain carry no codes from the earlier research and were assumed to be Selfit too (2021 Selfit price recorded, Selfit-only sizes added) – confirm with the distributor. Integrated-ring fittings are separate products named "Finolex SWR Integrated Ring …".
SWR standards: Finolex states pipes conform to IS 13592 and fittings to IS 14735.
GST 18% is believed correct for all items (plastic pipes/fittings 3917, valves 8481, solvent cement 3506) but must be confirmed by the shop's accountant.
Market prices (marketPrice) researched 24 Oct 2026 from public price lists and retailer listings; check before relying on them.

FINOLEX 2021 PRICE LIST (added 26 Oct 2026): the shop supplied a copy of the Finolex Industries "Plumbing & Sanitation Pipes & Fittings Price List w.e.f. 1st July 2021" (60 pages). Every priced line in it was added: ASTM Schedule 40/80 pipes and fittings, heavy pressure (15 kg/cm²) plumbing pipes, CPVC SDR 11/13.5 and Schedule 40/80 pipes and fittings (incl. concealed valves and mixer adaptors), SWR Selfit and integrated-ring pipes, cut pieces and fittings, underground drainage pipes, solvent cements, primer and rubber lubricant. The list states "Prices are ex-factory and exclusive of all applicable taxes", so listPrice is the 2021 list price excluding GST (listPriceIncludesTax false, no MRP). Pipes are priced per metre (the same rate for every stock length); everything else per piece. These prices are five years old: they are not applied automatically but arrive as pending price proposals (new variants only) for the owner to review in Dashboard → Price review, and each priceSource names the PDF page and Finolex material code. For variants that were already in the file the 2021 list price is only a record; the importer never uses it because those variants are already priced.

FINOLEX 2021 LIST – reading notes: every row was checked against the list itself (list price per piece × standard pack = list price per pack, and per-metre price × metres per pack = pack price, for all 1,230 priced lines) and the material codes run without gaps (4001–4080, 4501–4805, 5401–5406, 5501–5540, 6001–6330, 7001–7181, 7501–7731, 8501–8520, 9010–9034, 9106–9117). Nothing was left unread; pages 2, 4, 12–14, 23, 25, 37, 49, 51, 55–60 are covers, certificates, packing-colour charts and addresses without prices. The agriculture, casing and column pipes and the agriculture solvent cement are described in the list but not priced in it, so those existing products have no 2021 price. HSN codes of new products are as printed in the list (8 digits, e.g. 39174000 fittings, 39172390 pipes, 73069090 metal clamps, 35061000 solvent cement, 34039900 lubricant, 40169990 lip seal); Finolex prints 39174000 even for its ball valves, faucet valves and non-return valves, whereas the existing CPVC Ball Valve uses 8481 – the accountant should decide. New products have no images yet.

FINOLEX 2021 LIST – oddities kept as printed: the CPVC Elbow 90° – Brass Insert 25 mm row gives a reference size of 26.60 mm (28.60 elsewhere); the heavy pressure pipe table calls 20 mm "½"" (IS 4985 nominal sizes); the powder-coated metal clamp for ASTM pipe is listed with CPVC (CTS) reference sizes; the CPVC yellow solvent cement sizes are in ml in this list (the existing variant names say gm); one integrated-ring SWR pipe line (110 mm, 3 m, code 7012, ₹297/m) has no Type A/B heading and was added as its own product; two multi floor trap rows are marked "(NEW)" and were kept as separate "new model" variants; the faucet valve is listed in body types I and II (shown as two pictures in the list).

FOR THE OWNER: several existing marketPrice values were estimates (marked UNVERIFIED/low confidence) and are well below even the 2021 list prices before GST – e.g. ASTM Schedule 40 ½" pipe ₹44/m against a 2021 list of ₹85.50/m + GST, SWR Selfit Type A 75 mm ₹110/m against ₹213.50/m + GST. Dealer discounts on Finolex list prices are large, but these are worth checking with the distributor.

products.name: Finolex CPVC Pipe SDR 11
products.description: Chlorinated PVC pipe for hot and cold water supply lines, made by Finolex to IS 15778 in Copper Tube Size (CTS) dimensions. SDR 11 is the thicker-walled, higher-pressure class of the range and is identified by a red stripe on the pipe. The pipes are plain-ended, made from a lead-free compound and recommended for water up to 82 °C.
